title: VDBE post-commit WAL callback dispatch

scope.rationale: doWalCallbacks is the post-commit connection-level loop that samples every attached Btree's committed WAL frame count and invokes the registered hook only while prior hooks remain successful.

external_source_responsibilities: The source Btree-enter, sqlite3PagerWalCallback, and Btree-leave sequence for each attached Btree
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete post-commit database loop and hook-result gate are assigned. The named frame-count operation owns the exact per-Btree lock/pager sequence until source-layout pager integration.

inputs: Source-layout Sqlite3 with attached Db/Btree entries and a frame-count operation owning per-Btree locking
outputs: The first non-OK WAL-hook result, or OK after scanning all attached databases
contracts.ownership: No ownership transfer. Connection, Db names, Btrees, and hook context remain borrowed.
contracts.state_and_results: Every non-null Btree is sampled even after an earlier hook fails. Hooks run only for positive frame counts, when registered, and while the accumulated result remains OK.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: The injected frame-count operation owns Btree enter/pager callback/leave. User WAL hooks run after that lock scope, exactly as source. Pager I/O remains delegated.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: The first hook error suppresses later hooks without suppressing later frame-count cleanup/sampling; that error is returned unchanged.

representation_differences: The source Btree-enter/Pager-WAL-callback/Btree-leave triplet is represented by a named frame-count operation until the source-layout Btree points at the native pager owner.
The exact Sqlite3, Db, Btree, callback, argument, and schema-name fields remain source-layout representations.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace uses three attached Db entries, including a null Btree, two positive frame counts, and a first-hook error. It verifies that both Btrees are sampled, only the first hook runs, and the first error is returned.
internal_observations: hook call count and first frame count
oracle.normalization: Pointers are not compared; counts and result codes are exact. A pinned-C WAL/pager trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Pager I/O and Btree lock evidence remain external; source callback ordering is translated.
assurance.malformed_input: Null Btree slots and absent hooks are accepted source states.
assurance.continuation: Later Btrees are still sampled after the first hook error.
assurance.performance: One linear pass over connection.nDb with at most one frame sample and hook per attached Btree.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/vdbe_api.zig source-layout post-commit statement API layer
integration.native_call_path: The source-layout loop and native unit path are implemented; VDBE commit and exact pager frame-count integration remain pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. The bounded frontend retains its separate WAL callback path.

independent_review.notes: Requires pager/Btree integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

Add a pinned-C multi-database WAL hook trace.
Retire the bounded frontend WAL callback owner.
